summary: This bill prohibits the permanent or semi-permanent display of names of individuals, corporations, or other entities within the White House or on its grounds without the express approval of the Speaker and Minority Leader of the House of Representatives and the Curator of the White House, unless the display qualifies as a commemorative work under existing law.

scores.thoughts: The bill prohibits unauthorized permanent or semi-permanent name displays (including corporate or individual) at the White House and grounds, directly restricting potential commercial branding, sponsorships, or endorsements at the executive mansion. This is a narrow, site-specific rule rather than a broad reform of campaign finance or political spending, making the connection tangential to the bill's core purpose of White House preservation.
